//Settings: The PostgreSQL connection string comes from a deployed target's settings file (appsettings.Target.json, filled from the target's own database), this machine's appsettings.Local.json or DB_CONNECTION; nothing secret belongs here.
//Identity: The service runs the Form 1 module over PostgreSQL; the module's migration set builds the identity schema. The OIDC server's issuer, clients and keys (Identity:Server) and the Data Protection ring certificates (Identity:DataProtection) come from the target's settings file.
//Sign-in rules: Identity:Password (MinLength 15, MaxLength 128, IsDigitRequired, IsLowercaseRequired, IsUppercaseRequired, IsNonAlphanumericRequired, RequiredUniqueChars, IsAccountIdentifierRejected; Change:Confirmation None|Code|Link, Change:IsSignInAgainRequired), Identity:SignIn (IsConfirmedEmailRequired, IsConfirmedPhoneNumberRequired, IsEmailLoginAllowed) and Identity:Lockout (MaxFailedAttempts, DefaultLockout, IsEnabledForNewUsers) bind from the target's settings file; a value invalid on its own refuses the start.
//Email: Account emails and codes go over the SMTP relay of Identity:Email (From, FromName, Smtp:Host, Port, SecureSocket, Username, Password; a vault secret carries the password). With no Smtp:Host the instance boots and skips and logs every send. The links in the emails point at the hosted pages on the origin of Identity:Server:Issuer.
//Tokens: Identity:Tokens:SigningKey signs the confirmation, reset and forced-change tokens: base64 of at least 32 bytes (a vault secret), or the path of a file holding it. Only a local run may set Identity:Tokens:IsKeyEphemeral.
